Hi Tom / Sofia —

Thanks for the questions — happy to clarify the technical controls and timelines. Below are concise answers that you can pass to legal/ops. Happy to join a call for any deeper tech review.

1) SOC 2 Status
- Current status: SOC 2 Type II audit in progress (security + availability scope). Expected completion: Q1 2027 (target: 2027-03-31). We can share interim report docs where appropriate under NDA.

2) HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via our Dedicated and Private deployment options. We offer a BAA for customers processing PHI on eligible deployment types. For hosted customers with PHI, we typically recommend Private deployment; Rishi will follow up on contractual options and standard controls.

3) Deletion SLAs (account-level and user-level)
- Account-level deletion: We commit to removing customer data from primary production stores within 30 calendar days after receiving a verified deletion request, subject to any retention required by law or contract.
- User-level deletion / DSARs: We support per-user deletion requests; typical processing time: up to 30 days.
- Important: Backups and disaster recovery copies are treated separately — they are not deleted immediately on request to ensure recoverability. See backups section below.

4) Backups & log retention
- Default log retention: 90 days for application-level and operational logs.
- Backup retention: default 180 days for snapshot backups in hosted environments.
- Optional extensions: For Dedicated/Private customers we can configure longer retention (365 days) via contract and configuration — this is commonly handled as an addendum to the SLA and may affect cost.
- Deletion propagation: Deletion requests remove data from the primary store and logical indexes within the SLA window. Backups are immutable snapshots; standard process is to exclude customer data from new backups after deletion and allow existing snapshots to age out per configured retention window (unless legal obligations require earlier disposal).

5) Encryption & key management
- All data at rest is encrypted. For Hosted customers we manage keys (KMS). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys (CMK/HSM).

6) Next steps I recommend:
- Accept the 30-day deletion SLA for primary data in the draft or propose specific language.
- If Amaya requires 365d backups/log retention, we can provide an addendum and estimated delta to pricing — Rishi can lead that.
- If you want Neha to complete the vendor questionnaire directly, mark the rows for technical answers and I’ll populate them.

Attachments: (I’ve populated the technical tabs in the Amaya_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx and flagged backup/log questions)

– Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Marissa / Neha — thanks for the detailed responses and the populated questionnaire. A few items from legal/ops after an initial pass: 

- SOC 2: Q1 2027 target is acceptable; legal will want to see the interim evidence and expected date for final report once available. Please share the auditor and scope when convenient.
- Deletion SLA: Amaya can accept the 30-day primary data deletion SLA. We need explicit language in the SLA about backups: Amaya requests the option for 365-day backup retention, but also wants contractual confirmation that after the account deletion is processed, no new backups will include the deleted data and that existing backups will be retained only to the agreed retention window (we understand immutable snapshots may remain until expiration).
- HIPAA / BAA: legal requests a checklist of required controls to evaluate whether a Hosted->Dedicated migration is required for PHI. If you can provide a short table that maps Redwood controls to HIPAA safeguards that will speed the review.
- Questionnaire: Legal left a couple of clarifying questions in the XLSX — we’ve flagged the rows in the sheet. Please complete those by EOD Friday if possible.

Last ask: can you send a DocuSign link for the SLA addendum (we'll review it alongside the standard contract)? If you prefer to wait until we've agreed on retention windows, we can schedule signing after that.

Thanks —
Sofia Lopez
Sr. Security & Privacy Operations
Amaya Health
